visitCount.description: Number of persisted visit-gap-v1 visits at this site

get.description: Latest reliable sighting is max end_at of persisted visit-gap-v1 visits; null until a reliable visit exists. Raw activity contributes chip identity and separate server receipt time only. Uses frozen site attribution, never current deployments. UNKNOWN/unattributed observations are not assigned to a site. Ordered by reliable sighting descending (nulls last), then chipId ascending. limit 1..1000 (default 100), offset >= 0. Foreign/missing sites return 404.
